summary.whatChanges: Adds a `servers` option to the tRPC OpenAPI generator and a matching `--server-url` CLI flag, so generated documents can include an OpenAPI `servers` array. When omitted, no `servers` key is emitted. Exports a `ServerObject` type; docs/README updated (including awaiting `generateOpenAPIDocument`).
behaviorChanges: `generateOpenAPIDocument` accepts a `servers` array that is passed through into the generated document
New CLI flag `--server-url <url>` emits `servers: [{ url }]` in the output JSON
CLI help text and docs table now list `--server-url`
`ServerObject` is exported from the openapi package types
Documents still omit `servers` entirely when no URL is supplied
risks: Only a single server URL can be set via the CLI; multiple servers require the programmatic API
No validation of the provided URL, so a malformed `--server-url` is written straight into the spec
Docs now show `await generateOpenAPIDocument`, implying an async API that readers may have been calling synchronously
